## Highlights
- **📦 Getting ready for Alma+ 3.0 (sync between computers).** Install this version before 3.0. It quietly keeps a copy of your Alma+ data so 3.0 can bring everything over automatically.

## Why this is needed
- Alma+ 3.0 will sync your tasks, notes, links and settings to any computer where you're signed in to Chrome.
- For that, 3.0 gets a fixed extension ID. Chrome treats a new ID as a brand-new extension with empty storage, so your tasks, notes and files would look gone.
- This version saves a copy of all of it in Alma's page storage on **your computer only** (nothing is sent anywhere). 3.0 picks it up on its first run and then deletes the copy.

## Changes
- The copy stays up to date every time you add or change a task, note, file or setting.
- If you have very large attached files that don't fit, the copy keeps everything except those file contents (links, tasks and notes are always kept).
- Nothing looks different in Alma.

## How to update
1. Download the zip below and unzip it.
2. Copy its files over your old Alma+ folder (same place, same folder name).
3. Go to `chrome://extensions` and click reload ↻ on Alma+.
4. **Open Alma once** (any page, like Overview). That makes the copy. Then you're ready for 3.0.

> ⚠️ Don't remove the extension to update — removing it deletes your saved tasks. Back up your tasks first with **Back up tasks** on the To Do page if you're unsure.
